b2fb3931b154.text: Changes in fungal-associated volatiles may provide a screening window before visible spoilage. AeroSense aims to connect insect OR/Orco receptors in HEK293 cells, a weak-fluorescence reader and a fly-inspired decoder. Current evidence includes endpoint reporter images from one batch, a separate P2 kinetic pilot, reader simulations and computation on external metal-oxide sensor data. The integrated reader-to-decoder chain remains unproven. The intended output is a prompt for follow-up testing, not a mycotoxin concentration or a food-safety clearance.
